{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'

n_converted = loyal_data['converted'].sum()
conversion_fraction = n_converted / n_loyal

# Print only the exact numbers that will be in evidence
print(n_loyal)
print(n_converted)
print(conversion_fraction)"}
